build_note: The M12 port benchmark (D-84): the M11 library, libsodium-core 1.3.1 (Sodium.Core) at the same commit, ported to Rust, so the two targets compare. A netstandard2.0 and 2.1 library in C# 9 (37 files, 3.7k lines) over a shared project of 73 P/Invoke declarations into libsodium (src/Interop), with 230 NUnit tests on net6.0 (4.3k lines). The Rust calls libsodium itself, from the crate's native module (bindgen's declarations from sodium.h), so the run's image is M11's: the port image with Ubuntu 22.04's libsodium-dev 1.0.18 (bench/images/libsodium). The project checks integer overflow (CheckForOverflowUnderflow).
